text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Arima Kinen. Seiun Sky 
receives lavish praise from her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd cheered for Seiun Sky as well. 
That massive roar was directed not at a 
trickster, but at an undeniably top-class 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky successfully reeled in the 'big 
catch.' From now on, she would run as the 
undisputed heavy favorite—
